# ANALYSIS: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_OOS_VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** watcher_proposal  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate isolates the DTE variable by holding the vwap_continuation signal, ITM-2 strike, and -8%/+30% exit constant while varying DTE (0,1,2). The hypothesis is that longer DTE reduces theta decay on entry premium, increasing expectancy without relying on gap gambling, as evidenced by near-zero held-overnight % at the -8% stop.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers on the same vwap_continuation signal as the 0DTE baseline. Contract selection uses ITM-2 strike (strike_offset=-2) for all DTE buckets. Exit rules remain identical: -8% premium stop (catastrophe cap, chart-stop primary), +30% TP1 at 0.667 qty fraction, chandelier profit-lock, and 15:50 ET time stop. The only variable is DTE: 0DTE (same-day expiry), 1DTE (next-day weekly), 2DTE (second-day weekly). Real OPRA fills are used for all buckets via cached data.

2. **Sample bias:** Full OPRA dataset (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) used; no selection bias beyond strategy logic. Sample size: ~1,200 trading days. Overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward guards and random-entry null tests (p ≤ 0.045 per bucket).

5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: potential gap risk if -8% stop fails (held-overnight ~0% per leaderboard, but not zero). Max drawdown: unknown without equity curve. Blow-up scenario: IV crush on longer DTE positions if volatility drops post-entry.  
6. **Concentration:** Leaderboard states drop-top3 near full mean ($45-$59, not concentration). Top-5 days % of P&L: unknown without full P&L breakdown; NEEDS-CONCENTRATION disclosure.
